summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Goal for this session: add pagination to the GET /v1/invoices endpoint in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`.
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be referenced through `settings/vendor_sbx.toml` rather than an environment variable.
- Ruled out: disabling the idempotency middleware to stop the 409s. We tried it Tuesday and it produced duplicate invoices in staging. Not an option.
- Run “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” between other work, completing its eight supplied steps in order, one at a time.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.
- Integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64; ci-runner-small is retired and hangs.
- Drop pagination work for now. Instead, fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, causing customer 400s.
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Recent work
Rollout step 6 completed; step 4 was also successful. Worker retention fixes and regressions pass. CLI billing filters were consolidated; all 15 CLI tests and all 22 command tests pass, and duplicate currency help was removed.
